      Phin Lab Roastery — Vietnamese Coffee Roastery in Hoi An

      Our working roastery in peaceful Triêm Tây Village, where we roast, taste and explore Vietnamese coffee from green bean to cup.

      Coffee Roasting • Vietnamese Coffee • Roaster A Day • Triêm Tây Village

      Where Phin Coffee Is Roasted

      Phin Lab is our working coffee roastery in Triêm Tây Village, a peaceful part of Cam Kim Island just outside Hoi An Old Town.

      This is where we roast the Vietnamese coffee served across our Phin locations, working with beans sourced from coffee-growing regions around Vietnam and developing roast profiles for different brewing styles.

      Phin Lab is also where coffee lovers can get closer to the roasting process through our Roaster A Day experience, and where we prepare coffee for our wholesale café, restaurant and hotel partners.

      Vietnamese Coffee • Roasted in Hoi An • Coffee Experiences • Wholesale

      Roaster A Day — Hands-On Coffee Roasting in Hoi An

      Go behind the scenes at Phin Lab and experience what happens when green coffee becomes the coffee in your cup.

      During our Roaster A Day experience, you’ll explore Vietnamese coffee beans, learn how roasting changes flavour and aroma, and take part in a real roast with our coffee team.

      This is a deeper coffee experience for guests who want to understand roasting beyond simply brewing and drinking coffee.

      3.5 Hours • Hands-On Roasting • Vietnamese Coffee • Private Experience

      EXPLORE ROASTER A DAY →

      Wholesale Vietnamese Coffee for Cafés, Hotels & Restaurants

      Phin Lab also supplies freshly roasted Vietnamese coffee to cafés, restaurants and hotels looking for reliable coffee for their daily service.

      We can work with hospitality businesses to choose beans and roast profiles suited to their menu, brewing method and style of coffee service.

      Whether you need coffee for espresso, traditional phin brewing or other brewing methods, contact our roasting team to discuss your requirements and wholesale pricing.

      .

      CONTACT US FOR WHOLESALE DETAILS →

      Vietnamese Coffee, Roasted by Phin

      At Phin Lab, we roast Vietnamese coffee selected for different flavours and brewing styles. Our coffees include Arabica from Cầu Đất, Đà Lạt and Robusta from Gia Lai, two important coffee-growing regions of Vietnam.

      We develop different roast profiles depending on how the coffee will be used, from Light and Medium to Medium-Dark roasts. This allows us to prepare coffee for different needs — from filter and manual brewing to espresso and traditional Vietnamese phin coffee.

      The same approach also allows us to work with our wholesale partners to choose a coffee and roast profile that suits their café, restaurant or hotel.

      Cầu Đất Arabica • Gia Lai Robusta • Light • Medium • Medium-Dark
